== Course of events ==

As Glinda the Good pressed her claim on the Emerald City, seeking to restore its rightful rule, General Jinjur refused to give up her throne and declared war on Glinda and Ozma. Jinjur's defiance rejected any peaceful surrender of the power she held, setting her forces directly against Glinda and Ozma's claim to the throne. Tip, caught in the unfolding conflict between the two sides, was present as the confrontation took shape.

Jinjur's refusal and declaration of war hardened the standoff over the Emerald City into open conflict between her rule and the claims of Glinda and Ozma. It left the dispute over the throne to be settled by force rather than negotiation, drawing Tip further into the struggle between Jinjur and the assembled opposition.
